meta.notes: Agree with different questions; a concrete question separates them. Their agreement makes them neither truthful nor innocent. Two voices in one line, split by an em dash. The "lodger" statement starts here. Twenty-two fifty is theirs.

threads.topic: You told the officer she lodged here.
threads.source: B11, B14, S08. Paper names them as source.

threads.topic: Before the laundry clock rang, or after?
threads.source: S08, 4.3. Separates them; the sighting comes only from the specific question.
Comedy. Bank lines. Ordinary appointment and a verified mirror only.
FICTION; see design/ORISON_YEAR_SUBPLOTS_2026-11-01.md. Not at Home. They agree until a concrete question.

tg_l1.line: We agreed she lodged. — She was always on the roof. — Where would a person go up, if she didn't live up? — Quite.

choices.label: Did you ever see her come home?

tg_l2.line: We see everyone come home. — Eleven o'clock is checkout. — It is, isn't it? — We told him what was likely.

choices.label: She had a shop across the road.

tg_l3.line: So she did. — So we've heard. — I always said so. — We agree you said so.

tg_s1.line: We agreed it was late. — Quite late. — Before. — After the lift.

choices.label: Which? You first. On the stairs, that night. What did you see?

tg_s1s.line: It's nice how you wait. — We thought you might. — We've been here a long time. — Have we? Yes.

tg_s2.line: A lady in gloves going down, with a lamp she did not light. — Ten to eleven. — I'd have said a gentleman. — You'd have said anything. — I would. It's very restful. — She had a good bag. — Did she? — I don't know now.

tg_r1.line: I explained to the doctor my dread of being abandoned. — He checked his watch and said our time was up. — It was your time. — I said our.

choices.label: What about the mirror on four?

tg_r2.line: The mirror showed me Tuesday, Thursday, and a gentleman who looked disappointed in all three. — That's the wardrobe. — I thought we agreed about the wardrobe.

tg_q1.line: We have. — We were. — It was very nice. — We all agree it was very nice.

tg_q2.line: Thursday. — Tuesday. — There was a band. — There was no band. — Well, it was very nice.
